Accepted change: 8 magnet trims (DAL x4, WAS x2, MIA x2) + 1 New Orleans re-key (q12 D->C, 'the long shot nobody believed'), fixing the Dallas star-chase magnet that swallowed Phoenix (4.7%->100%) and separating the Orlando/New Orleans near-twins (both now self-land). meta.synthetic_caveat: Signatures pin coreProfile to each teams own teamDims and use that teams signature module answers; they measure ENGINE BEHAVIOR (reachability), not real-taker prevalence. Random fixtures reuse the prior baselines uniform inputs, re-baselined on the CURRENT (post-decompression) engine. The prior committed baseline predated core decompression, so raw winner drift vs it is not attributable to this change. Isolating scoring alone on the current engine, the accepted trims moved exactly 3 of 40 random winners (rnd_001, rnd_018, rnd_026), all Dallas/Washington magnet-shedding in the intended direction. All 30 signatures self-land. Reachability is not prevalence.
